subject: Request: Approval for security staffing pipeline & offer bands
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Approval for security staffing pipeline & offer bands

Team —

Following the Q1 review and the incident post-mortem, Security needs approval to move forward with two priority hires this quarter:

- Senior Security Engineer (SecEng) — IC lead to stabilize inference runtime hardening and lead on deployment hardening runs.
- GRC Program Manager — to own vendor risk, audit backlog (SOC2 readiness items), and internal policy remediation.

Why now: SecEng is critical to close an operational gap we saw in the last incident; GRC is blocking several enterprise procurement processes (potentially $3–4M ARR pipeline).

Proposed ask:
- 1x Senior SecEng, band E4 (hire range $210k–$260k total comp) — initial offer target $225k for candidate market fit.
- 1x GRC PM, band M3 (hire range $140k–$175k total comp) — initial offer target $150k.

I've attached the comp band matrix and a short summary of the proposed offers. Budget note: SecEng can be offset with an existing open headcount in infra (reallocation request pending). Marcus, can you confirm if we have budget headroom under the security pool for Q1?

Approval items needed:
1) Budget sign-off (Marcus)
2) Compensation band confirmation (Laura)
3) Go/no-go on engaging preferred recruiter (I propose TalentBridge — Lena is on copy)

If we can greenlight by EOD Wednesday I will proceed to extend verbal offers and get formal approvals queued.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Director, Security Engineering
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_comp_bands_q1_2027.xlsx (xlsx, 58 KB)]
[Attachment: proposed_offers_summary.pdf (pdf, 22 KB)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lena Ortiz <lena@talentbridge.io>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Approval for security staffing pipeline & offer bands

On Mon, Feb 22, 2027 at 9:12 AM Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Following the Q1 review ...

Thanks for the write-up Jordan. Quick thoughts:

- I support prioritizing the Senior SecEng; agree that market for top infra+LLM-sec engineers is tight. I'm comfortable moving the target offer for SecEng to $235k (within band) if Laura confirms band allowances.
- GRC PM looks correctly banded; we should include a clear incentive tied to audit closures (simpler for compensation committees).
- Recruiter: fine to engage TalentBridge on a contingency plus exclusive window of 3 weeks for the top shortlisted candidates. Lena — please confirm availability and expected time-to-submittal.

Marcus — please confirm budget by COB Tuesday. If we get all three confirmations, Jordan proceed to extend verbal offers and begin candidate negotiation with the targets above.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Product Security
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 Feb 2027 10:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Approval for security staffing pipeline & offer bands

On Mon, Feb 22, 2027 at 11:03 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks for the write-up Jordan. Quick thoughts:

Appreciate the context. HR has reviewed the attached bands and the proposed targets. Notes:

- Senior SecEng: band E4 is appropriate; target $235k is allowable but we should reserve discretion to go up to $245k for exceptional candidates with LLM infra experience. Approvals needed above $245k will require comp committee sign-off.
- GRC PM: band M3 approved at $150k target. Consider a 10% sign-on for candidates who would otherwise accept competitor offers.

Please prepare an offer memo per candidate (1 page) that includes: proposed base, equity target, sign-on (if any), role justification, and hiring timeline. Once I receive both memos, I will fast-track band sign-off and send via DocuSign for the offer letters.

Marissa — can your team collect the role rationale and the preferred interview panel list so we can keep the slate moving?

Laura Bennett
Head of Total Rewards
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_comp_bands_q1_2027_v2.xlsx (xlsx, 62 KB)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lena Ortiz <lena@talentbridge.io>
Date: Wed, 24 Feb 2027 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Approval for security staffing pipeline & offer bands

Thanks — quick alignment:

- Marcus confirmed budget headroom for one of the roles (SecEng) via internal reallocation; finance will confirm the second role's funding in next month’s operating cadence (Marcus — noted).
- Laura approved bands and the discretionary ceiling; I will prepare the two one-page offer memos and share by EOD Thursday.
- Lena (TalentBridge) to start candidate outreach focused on SecEng priority; please submit 4–6 resumes in the first two weeks.
- Marissa — please assemble the interview panel and the role rationale doc Jordan referenced.

Next steps: Jordan to circulate offer memos -> Laura to sign-off -> Marissa to route for DocuSign -> I will coordinate final approvals from VP+ for any sign-on exceptions.

If no objections, I will proceed with verbal outreach to the preferred SecEng candidate tomorrow afternoon.

Jordan Blake
Director, Security Engineering
Redwood Inference
[Inline: —Sent from my laptop —]
